ruleDefinitions.name: Potential CommandLine Path Traversal Via Cmd.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential path traversal attempt via cmd.exe. Could indicate possible command/argument confusion/hijacking

sequences.query: ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "cmd\.exe") AND ((parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/c.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/k.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/r.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/c.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/k.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/r.*"))) AND (parent_process_command_line = "\/\.\.\/\.\.\/" OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/\\\.\\\.\\/\\\.\\\.\\/.*"))) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Tasktop\\\\keycloak\\\\bin\\\\\\/\\\.\\\.\\/\\\.\\\.\\/jre\\\\bin\\\\java.*"))
